MiniQuake Vulkan-Headers subset

Upstream: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers
Commit: f9973cd97e6f3584707e7ef1c425e336f1b92a5b

Only the C headers needed by MiniQuake's dynamically loaded Vulkan 1.3
backend and the upstream license files are vendored. MiniQuake does not link
against the Vulkan loader import library and requires no Vulkan SDK at build
or run time.
